description: For financial advisors (requires a MySSAgent advisor account — sign in with your myssagent.com advisor account when prompted). Re-runs the full MySSAgent engine for one of YOUR clients on the earnings record and household data already on file, then stores the refreshed results. Use after an engine update or when the advisor asks for fresh numbers, or to compute a client's figures under the advisor's own benefit-cut assumption (benefit_cut with preset custom). It cannot add a new client or ingest an SSA statement — new clients are provisioned in the advisor dashboard. Requires the advisor_client_id from list_clients. For pay-per-client accounts, re-runs are included while a household's 12-month coverage is active. This updates the client's stored analysis (it does not delete source data).

advisor_client_id.description: The client's id from list_clients (a UUID).

benefit_cut.description: Optional. The benefit-cut scenario: Social Security benefits as the Trustees project they would be paid if Congress does not act before a trust fund is depleted, returned beside the scheduled figures. "trustees_oasi" is the 2026 Trustees Report projection for the Old-Age and Survivors Insurance fund (78% of scheduled benefits payable from October 2032); "trustees_combined" is the hypothetical combined retirement and disability funds (83% from July 2034); "custom" takes effective_month (YYYY-MM, 2027-01 to 2045-12) and payable_pct (50 to 100). Use it for questions about benefit cuts, trust-fund depletion or a haircut to Social Security. Payable figures, checks paid in full before the cut, and the breakeven shift come only from this parameter: they cannot be reproduced by applying a percentage to the scheduled figures, because checks paid before the effective month are paid in full.

effective_month.description: Custom only: first reduced month, YYYY-MM.

payable_pct.description: Custom only: percent of scheduled benefits payable.
